registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register for request generation, fallback override, and sticky fault clearing.

fields.name: REQ_ARM
fields.description: Write 1 to arm a new model request opportunity when inputs are valid and no request is outstanding. Self-clears by hardware after request acceptance or rejection.

fields.name: FAULT_CLEAR
fields.description: Write 1 to clear sticky fault bits. Clear action is sampled on write and self-clears.

fields.name: SLEW_EN
fields.description: Enable optional slew-rate limiting.

fields.name: CFG_VALID_ONLY
fields.description: When set, command valid is asserted only after full safety qualification, clamp, and optional slew processing; intended to reflect the mandatory safety path.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; read as zero.

registers.name: STATUS0
registers.description: Packed fault and state status, byte 0.

fields.name: INVALID_INPUT
fields.description: Sticky fault: invalid geometry or out-of-envelope flow input.

fields.name: STALE_RESPONSE
fields.description: Sticky fault: response sequence mismatch or age beyond freshness threshold.

fields.name: TIMEOUT
fields.description: Sticky fault: outstanding request exceeded timeout supervision.

fields.name: CLAMP_ACTIVE
fields.description: Sticky fault/status: command was saturated to clamp bounds.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Current fallback state indicator; asserted whenever safe fallback command selection is active.

fields.name: RESPONSE_MISSING
fields.description: Sticky fault: no acceptable response present while request is outstanding or control requires validated data.

fields.name: OUTSTANDING_REQ
fields.description: Current request outstanding indicator.

fields.name: COMMAND_VALID
fields.description: Current actuator_command_valid state.

registers.name: STATUS1
registers.description: Packed supervisory status, byte 1.

fields.name: RESP_MATCH
fields.description: Indicates the most recently observed response sequence matched the outstanding request sequence.

fields.name: RESP_COMPLETE
fields.description: Indicates completeness checks passed for drag_force_in, lift_force_in, and the configured third-response qualifier.

fields.name: FLOW_IN_RANGE
fields.description: Indicates stream_velocity_mps is within the inclusive 20 to 55 m/s envelope when flow_conditions_valid is asserted.

fields.name: GEOM_VALID
fields.description: Mirrors current geometry validity qualification.

fields.name: ENABLE_IN
fields.description: Mirrors actuator_enable_in.

fields.name: REQ_ISSUED
fields.description: Indicates a model_request_valid strobe was issued in the current or last qualified cycle.

fields.name: RESP_ACCEPTED
fields.description: Indicates the last response passed freshness, sequence, and completeness checks.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; read as zero.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_L
registers.description: Outstanding request sequence counter, low byte.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_L
fields.description: Low byte of the internal request sequence counter associated with the outstanding request.

registers.name: REQ_SEQ_H
registers.description: Outstanding request sequence counter, high byte.

fields.name: REQ_SEQ_H
fields.description: High byte of the internal request sequence counter associated with the outstanding request.

registers.name: RESP_SEQ_L
registers.description: Last observed response sequence tag, low byte.

fields.name: RESP_SEQ_L
fields.description: Low byte of model_response_seq captured for status visibility.

registers.name: RESP_SEQ_H
registers.description: Last observed response sequence tag, high byte.

fields.name: RESP_SEQ_H
fields.description: High byte of model_response_seq captured for status visibility.

registers.name: RESP_AGE_L

fields.name: RESP_AGE_L

registers.name: RESP_AGE_H

fields.name: RESP_AGE_H

registers.name: STREAM_VEL_L

fields.name: STREAM_VEL_L
fields.description: Low byte of stream_velocity_mps.

registers.name: STREAM_VEL_H

fields.name: STREAM_VEL_H

registers.name: VEH_GEOM_ID_L

registers.name: FAULT_CLEAR_EVENT
registers.description: Write-one pulse register for explicit sticky fault clear request.

fields.name: CLEAR_ALL_STICKY
fields.description: Write 1 to request clearing all sticky fault bits on the next clock edge. Other bits are reserved.

fields.name: RESERVED
fields.description: Reserved; write as zero.

fields.name: CFG_FRESH_THR_L

sources.name: FAULT_STATUS_CHANGE
sources.description: Optional level or pulse indication of a sticky fault transition or newly asserted fault_status_out bit. Not required by the top-level digital ports and only present if the integration environment maps an interrupt out of the register block.

sources.name: COMMAND_VALID_PULSE
sources.description: Optional pulse indication when actuator_command_valid asserts for software observation. Not required by the top-level digital ports and only present if the integration environment maps an interrupt out of the register block.

init_sequence: Write CTRL.FAULT_CLEAR=1 to ensure sticky faults are cleared after reset observation if needed.
Program CFG_FRESH_THR_L/H, CFG_TIMEOUT_L/H, CLAMP_MIN*, CLAMP_MAX*, SLEW_DELTA*, and FALLBACK_CMD* before arming operation.
Verify STATUS0.FALLBACK_ACTIVE is set after reset and STATUS1.GEOM_VALID/STATUS1.FLOW_IN_RANGE are correct for the current inputs.
Set CTRL.SLEW_EN as required by the integration policy.
Set CTRL.CFG_VALID_ONLY=1 to keep command validity tied to full safety qualification.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS0 and STATUS1 until STATUS0.FALLBACK_ACTIVE deasserts and STATUS1.RESP_ACCEPTED asserts for operational mode.
Monitor STATUS0.INVALID_INPUT, STATUS0.STALE_RESPONSE, STATUS0.TIMEOUT, STATUS0.CLAMP_ACTIVE, and STATUS0.RESPONSE_MISSING for sticky fault conditions.
Read REQ_SEQ and RESP_SEQ bytes to diagnose request/response matching.
Read RESP_AGE and stream/geometry shadow status bytes as needed for diagnostics.
If a sticky fault is observed, write CTRL.FAULT_CLEAR=1 after the underlying condition is removed.
irq_sequence: On FAULT_STATUS_CHANGE, read STATUS0/STATUS1 to identify the asserted fault cause.
If COMMAND_VALID_PULSE is used, log the valid command event and sampled actuator_command_out value.
Clear sticky faults only after software confirms the external condition has resolved and the control loop is safe to re-arm.

consistency_notes: This register map is derived only from DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON and remains compatible with the flat top-level module.
No additional hierarchy, ports, AXI/APB protocol, or incompatible interfaces are introduced.
All wide configuration and status values are split across 8-bit registers because the implied firmware-visible interface is byte-addressed custom/reg-like rather than an explicit bus protocol.
Top-level RTL ports are unchanged; these registers are internal integration/control observability points only.
Sticky fault clear behavior is modeled as write-one-to-clear through CTRL.FAULT_CLEAR and FAULT_CLEAR_EVENT, consistent with the safety wrapper specification.
